recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-39644 unless the work group reopens broader aggregation guidance outside this resolved code definition.
issue_request: FHIR-39644 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked that AggregationMode bundled clarify what it means when the resource described by a profile is not actually in a Bundle, resolving to: "When the resource is in a Bundle, the resource the reference points to will be found in the same bundle as the resource that includes the reference."
initial_application: Commit ff9dc14a8178578051a896b9d09f14ee4c3a2101 explicitly applied FHIR-39644 on 2023-02-10 by changing source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from the unconditional bundled definition to the resolved conditional wording. The current active source still contains that exact text.
additional_context: The Zulip #conformance Aggregation Question thread records the originating implementer question and Grahame's view that references do not have to be bundled when the resource itself is not in a Bundle. FHIR-I WGM 202301 minutes record the Persuasive with Modification vote. Earlier related issues FHIR-14402 and FHIR-26386 provide adjacent aggregation/reference-resolution guidance but do not change the seed issue's target wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml:8648 already matches the Jira resolution exactly, source/fhir.ini maps elementdefinition to the active ElementDefinition datatype page, and the R5 generated history includes the same bundled definition.

related_jiras.note: Earlier published aggregationMode guidance explains that aggregation modes impose reference-resolution requirements when present; it is background for the seed but not an independent decision here.
Earlier published logical-reference guidance says aggregation restrictions are moot for identifier-only references; it supports the bounded interpretation but did not require a seed source change.
